speaker: josias_thwaite
text: And fourteenthly. The precept is a small thing, and a small thing kept is how a city is kept. Blue starch is a colour put upon hunger.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: I have done. Go to your dinners. Look at your bands in the daylight, and not in a mercer's shop.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sound doctrine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Fourteen parts of it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You counted. That is the first sermon you ever heard to the end.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard the glass. The glass finishes when it finishes. I like a thing that knows its own end.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You heard him. Do not spend the walk unpicking it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Who is to decide where a permitted shade ends and an offence begins?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not I.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Nor I. The precept named a colour. It did not name a court to try a grey.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I washed it white on Wednesday. If a grey comes back in the drying, is the grey the offence, or only the weather?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep the white you have. Do not ask the roof. The roof had one customer, and she has gone.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: That woman may deal with a beadle. You may deal with the pot.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I want the rule to have an edge. A rule with no edge is only a mood, and a mood changes on a Sunday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then you listened harder than the pews did.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Home. The dinner will not wait on a shade of linen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Fourteen. I shall not get the hour back, and I am not sure I want it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will want the dinner. Philosophy does not keep.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: If his ruff is white, and mine is white, are we the same case?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: His is ten yards off and does not speak. Yours asks the question. I know which of the two I can answer.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Answer her at the table, if you must answer her. Not in the porch. The porch is for going through.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: She was out before the last word. I saw the door, not her face.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A quick woman. I am not the man who says whether she was a wise one.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are the man who counted to fourteen. Come and eat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am coming. Fourteen is enough counting for one Sunday.
